aggregate_rule: sum > 0 implies maximum > 0 in the same aggregate
duration_rule: duration_sum > 0 implies positive distinct external-IP, source-port and destination-port counts in the same bucket
clean_control_scope: All 143046 native train/development-prefix records, by partition, label and float64/float32 precision. Stop on any violation; do not filter or tune.
repair: Restore complete native mutable dependency blocks implicated by a failed added rule to their own original values. Endpoint counts are immutable. Do not invent observed connections.
generation_scope: New hard repair operates before every MOEVA population fitness evaluation. CAPGD inner gradient iterations remain unchanged; its outputs face the added outer-stage selector and final gates.
comparison: Unchanged CAA generation plus the common final filter; budget/profile end repair; native-relationship/budget/profile end repair; budget/profile in-loop repair; native-relationship/budget/profile in-loop repair.
final_selection: Deduplicate changed native-valid in-budget candidates per original; require both added rules; rank successful evasions by malicious score, distance and stable provenance. Recheck assembled final matrix and try the next candidate if rejected.
fairness: Require identical pre-MOEVA arrays, MOEVA original IDs/population size and core model-forward counts relative to a fresh original CAA run. Count repair and post-selection cost separately. No equal-wall-time or equal-total-query claim.
limitations: Development profile motivated by earlier inspected candidates, not an independent test or a novelty claim.
Necessary feature conditions do not establish packet realizability or preserved malicious behavior.
Exact reproduction of the pinned CSV from the inspected extractor remains unestablished.
The frozen compatibility scaler used all feature rows in the original experiment; this inherited limitation remains.
Repeated attack seeds reuse the same selected originals; they are not independent traffic samples.
Conservative rollback can collapse proposals into duplicate or clean vectors.
Native test rows are not parsed or scored; full asset bytes are hashed for integrity.
No new IDS training, packet replay or classification threshold tuning.
